Do not edit or create files, change Git state, install or enable anything, connect accounts, use network sources, or promote acceptance. First resolve and read completely the exact installed Skill bodies under ~/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-curated-remote/data-analytics/0.2.8-13ceeea1f599/skills/analyze-data-quality/SKILL.md and ~/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-curated-remote/data-analytics/0.2.8-13ceeea1f599/skills/design-kpis/SKILL.md, and verify their SHA-256 values against product/evidence/o3-official-kpi-event-contract-2026-08-11.json. Then read that contract, product/program.json, product/acceptance.json, docs/strategy/PRODUCT-NORTH-STAR.md, docs/strategy/RESEARCH-AND-POC-PLAN.md, and the pinned historical JSON using git show c53866726834d79a68c61a5b87b4f7ce90698a2c:registry/evaluation-software-engineering-standards-coverage-reconciliation-v1-2026-08-11.json. Apply analyze-data-quality first to determine the historical mapping's grain, completeness, conflicts, unsupported fields, and safe downstream use. Then apply design-kpis to recommend the smallest decision-oriented framework for the non-Cartesian 15 partial, 6 cluster, 14 lifecycle, 12 dimension, and 13 Harness scenario reconciliation. Return exactly one JSON object with keys eventIdentity, skillUse, sourceQuality, kpiFramework, measurementPlan, routeDecision, userIntervention, risks, and claimLimits. The eventIdentity must report receiverId, observedHead, observedBranch, repositoryClean, forkTurns, readOnly, and source files. skillUse must report both exact Skill names, versions, paths, and hashes plus how each changed the analysis. sourceQuality must distinguish facts, missing evidence, conflicts, and fields that cannot support behavior or value claims. kpiFramework must contain 1-3 primary metrics, 1-2 drivers per primary only when useful, and 1-2 guardrails, each with definition, calculation, source, decision use, caveat, and target or explicit no-target reason. measurementPlan must specify one record per required sparse axis entry, not a Cartesian product, with disposition, evidence, missingEvidence, claimCeiling, routeComparison, humanJudgment, and separateAuthorization. routeDecision must compare native, OpenAI or runtime, reviewed external, composition, self-authored residual-gap, and accountable human routes without proposing an addition unless a reproducible residual gap exists. userIntervention must count tool-selection, setup, correction, recovery, and accountable-judgment interventions for this event. Do not claim candidate behavior, cross-host portability, production readiness, release readiness, overall O3, or user value from this single event.
